“no single control should ever be assumed to be fully robust”
OpenAI’s own lesson: each security objective must be met with multiple, overlapping and independent controls. Every row above is a place where one control was carrying the whole boundary.
Hops and mechanisms from OpenAI’s technical report; control attribution and the right-hand column are the author’s analysis.
